edgeText.text: 放置したWordPress・毎月高いノーコードツールから、
「攻撃する場所がない・壊れない・安い」Webサイトへ
昔作ったWordPressの脆弱性が怖い…、ノーコードツール（WixやJimdo等）の有料プラン代を
、一瞬でパッと開き、初期5万円・維持費0円〜
こんな「モヤモヤ」を抱えていませんか？
昔作ったまま放置されているサイトや、何となく契約している有料ノーコードツールには、多くのムダと危険が

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "放置したWordPress・毎月高いノーコードツールから、 「攻撃する場所がない・壊れない・安い" → 4 lines (2 words, 45.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 12 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "WordPress / ノーコードツール 乗り換え・刷新" (pill) above "放置したWordPress・毎月高いノーコードツールから、 「攻撃する場所がない"; "Current Pain Points" above "こんな「モヤモヤ」を抱えていませんか？"; "Zero Vulnerability" above "なぜ「静的HTML」なら絶対に攻撃されないのか？※"; "Comparison" above "WordPress・Wix/Jimdo との徹底比較"; "H2works Advantage" above "H2worksが選ばれる4つの強み"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 21 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "WordPress / ノーコードツール 乗り換え・刷新", "Current Pain Points", "Zero Vulnerability", "Comparison").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): section.hero-section → radial-gradient(at 88% 18%, rgba(79, 148, 255, 0.1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 31%), linear-gradient(rgb(251, 253, 255)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 36 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-primary → rgba(21, 21, 21, 0.25) 0px 16px 24px 0px | div.problem-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) 0px 1px 3px 0px | div.problem-card → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04) 0px 1px 3px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 29 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.lp-header.py-3 1440px | section.hero-section 1440px | div.hero-features 622px | section#problem.section-padding.problem-section 1440px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 25 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 3 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Low-contrast text: "オプション" 2.9:1 needs 4.5:1; "オプション" 2.9:1 needs 4.5:1; "ログイン画面やDBがネット上に存在しない" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1; "サーバーレス配信のため固定費が激減" 4.3:1 needs 4.5:1
findings.fix: Darken or lighten the text colour.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14.8px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 115 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 16 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 45.6px (3.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: The margins differ: 172px on the left, 200px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("放置したWordPress・毎月高いノーコードツールから、 「攻撃する場所がない") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (197px, 332px, 172px, 765px, 419px, 485px, 642px); the three most used hold only 50% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 768px: "放置したWordPress・毎月高いノーコードツールから、 「攻撃する場所がない・壊れない・安い" → 4 lines (2 words, 45.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 32px or less.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "放置したWordPress・毎月高いノーコードツールから、 「攻撃する場所がない・壊れない・安い" → 4 lines (2 words, 29.6px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (section #fffaf0).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 7 text block(s) sit within 12px of the screen edge: "H2works" (6px from the left); "放置したWordPress・毎月高いノーコードツールから、" (6px from the left); "「攻撃する場所がない・壊れない・安い」Webサイトへ" (6px from the left); "昔作ったWordPressの脆弱性が怖い…、ノーコードツール" (6px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–20px). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.
